style.backgroundSystem: seamless paper-white, warm off-white and neutral mist-grey studio surfaces, plus one flat accent panel in #C18F4A; never gradients, never environmental clutter, never printed scenery
style.iconSystem: thin 1px line glyphs in #2D2D2D only; four-step index bars where one segment is solid #2D2D2D and the rest are #EAE7E1; no 3D badges, no gold seals, no filled colour icons
style.lightingSystem: soft high-key studio light, front-left key with a white bounce fill on the shadow side; close-up and macro shots switch to one raking side light to read the rib relief; shadow direction stays consistent across the whole set, contact shadows always present
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium womenswear knitwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm off-white #F4F1EC, neutral mist grey #EAE7E1, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and one caramel-camel accent #C18F4A; neutral warm studio tone; modern geometric sans-serif with Chinese callouts wrapped in 「」 and thin letter-spaced latin sub-labels; seamless matte paper and light-stone surfaces only, no gradients; soft high-key front-left key with white bounce fill, single raking side light for detail and macro shots, consistent shadow direction and real contact shadows; thin 1px line icons and four-step index bars; relaxed drop-shoulder garment presentation with the asymmetric fringed hem never cropped and no visible face; stable product scale and placement across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no watermark, no QR code, no price digits.
noDrift: no recoloured or drifting garment colours in variant panels
no visible model faces or recognisable likeness
no watermarks, store badges, membership badges, QR codes or price digits
style.presentationRules: the knit always reads as a relaxed drop-shoulder pullover with the asymmetric hem and fringe fully inside frame; on-model crops sit above the jawline so no face appears; garment scale stays identical across the triptych and the colourway row; knit texture must stay visible, never smoothed
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper backdrop for standing shots, matte light-stone counter for flat-lays; no gloss, no mirror reflection, no visible weave in the backdrop
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; Chinese callouts wrapped in 「」, thin letter-spaced latin sub-labels under section headlines; headline 28-40pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt; hairline rules and one dashed section divider style; never mix serif, handwritten or retro lettering
